results.title: Former Miss Switzerland accuses Donald Trump of rape
results.content: Donald Trump has been accused of rape by a model and former Miss Switzerland in a report produced by the Democratic Party.

results.title: China’s families are now supporting more old people than kids
results.content: Families in China are now supporting more elderly people than children, the government has said.

results.title: Egypt court fines journalist Lina Attalah and orders news site’s closure
results.content: The editor-in-chief of the independent Egyptian news outlet Mada Masr was detained for several hours after a court convicted her of managing an unlicensed website and ordered its closure, her lawyers say.

results.title: IERPP demands full account of 24-hour economy spending
results.content: The Institute of Economic Research and Public Policy (IERPP) is demanding that the government publish a comprehensive financing and implementation report on the 24-Hour Economy programme, detailing funds disbursed, expenditure incurred and projects completed.

results.title: Dutch zookeeper dies after being mauled by leopard
results.content: An experienced keeper at a Dutch zoo has died days after being mauled in a leopard enclosure, the safari park has confirmed.

results.title: King Charles acknowledges ‘suffering of the past’ as Caribbean tour begins
results.content: King Charles has arrived in the Bahamas for a nine-day Caribbean tour, the first time he has visited the region as monarch.

results.title: Osaka ‘not far off’ her best but often ponders future
results.content: Naomi Osaka says she is "not far off" the form that brought her four Grand Slam titles, but admits she has thought about quitting and often ponders her future.

results.title: Venus Williams loses again – to opponent 28 years younger
results.content: Former world number one Venus Williams lost her 16th straight singles match, beaten by an opponent 28 years younger at the Guangzhou Open.

results.title: Money politics is pushing women and youth out – Inusah Fuseini
results.content: Former NDC MP for Tamale Central, Inusah Fuseini, has warned that the rising cost of politics is shutting women and young people out of public life.

results.title: Make TESCON NPP’s intellectual powerhouse — Asenso-Boakye
results.content: The New Patriotic Party’s (NPP) student wing must evolve into a centre for policy thinking and leadership training if it is to make a lasting contribution to the party and Ghana’s development, the founding President of the Tertiary Students Confederacy (TESCON), Francis Asenso-Boakye, has said.

results.title: NDC constitution lacks mechanism to punish electoral inducement – Inusah Fuseini
results.content: Former Tamale Central MP, Inusah Fuseini, says the National Democratic Congress (NDC) lacks a clear constitutional mechanism to punish electoral inducement, leaving disciplinary action open to challenge.

results.title: Gender Ministry steps in to support students in alleged Obuasi SHTS sex abuse case
results.content: The Minister for Gender, Children and Social Protection, Dr Agnes Naa Momo Lartey, has met some students affected by the alleged sexual abuse at Obuasi Senior High Technical School (SHTS), assuring them of the government’s support as investigations into the case continue.

results.title: Man City players can block out ‘noise’ of away fans – Maresca
results.content: Manchester City suffered their first Premier League defeat of the season at a boisterous Aston Villa on Saturday, amid persistent reminders of their financial charges.

results.title: Arsenal loses to 4th-tier Fleetwood on penalties in English League Cup stunner
results.content: Fleetwood Town pulled off one of the biggest upsets in Carabao Cup history, beating Premier League champions Arsenal in an astounding penalty shootout to reach the quarter-finals.

results.title: Captain Xhaka allowed to play for Switzerland again
results.content: Granit Xhaka and Breel Embolo will both be allowed to play for Switzerland again next month following an investigation into forged Covid-19 vaccination certificates obtained by the pair.

results.title: Fleetwood-Arsenal halted for eight minutes because of drone
results.content: Arsenal's match against Fleetwood Town in the last 16 of the Carabao Cup was delayed for more than eight minutes after a drone flew over the stadium during play.

results.title: Barcelona fined £503 over approach for Alvarez
results.content: Barcelona have been fined €602 (£503) after Atletico Madrid complained about contact the club made with striker Julian Alvarez.

results.title: Alexander brothers each sentenced to 30 years in prison for sex trafficking case
results.content: Three brothers - two of them wealthy real-estate moguls - were sentenced to 30 years each in prison for drugging and raping dozens of women over decades.

results.title: One dead, 14 injured in Akuse–Akosombo highway crash
results.content: One person has died, and 14 others have sustained serious injuries in a collision involving a Toyota Hiace and a Peugeot saloon car on the Akuse–Akosombo Highway in the Eastern Region.

results.title: Ecobank Group profit before tax hits US$737 million for first nine months of 2026
results.content: Ecobank Group has reported continued growth in its financial results for the first nine months of 2026, despite an operating environment characterised by inflationary pressures, foreign exchange volatility and slower economic activity in parts of Africa.

results.title: Nanotyrannus skeleton sells for $47.3m at New York auction
results.content: The mounted skeleton of a newly identified dinosaur once mistaken for a young Tyrannosaurus rex has sold at auction for a colossal $47.3m (£35.5m).

results.title: Mbappé sorry for ‘ill-judged’ Mao remark after backlash in China
results.content: Kylian Mbappé has apologised for "ill-judged" comments about late Chinese leader Mao Zedong, which led several Chinese brands to drop him.

results.title: South Africa evacuation expenditure ‘smacks of a grand scheme of corruption’ – Abu Jinapor
results.content: The Ranking Member on Parliament’s Foreign Affairs Committee, Samuel Abdulai Jinapor, has accused the Foreign Affairs Ministry of failing to adequately account for expenditure on the evacuation of Ghanaians from South Africa, describing the entire exercise as a “grand scheme of corruption to siphon public funds”.

results.title: Ex-wife of Zimbabwe’s vice-president freed after collapse of attempted murder case
results.content: The former wife of Zimbabwe's vice-president has been freed from remand after seven years while on trial for his attempted murder.

results.title: Gold Fields Health outreach screens 735 people, refers 21 suspected breast cancer cases
results.content: A health outreach programme organised by the Gold Fields Ghana Foundation and its partners has provided screening and general healthcare services to 735 people in Samahu and Abekoase in the Western Region, with 21 suspected breast cancer cases referred for further assessment.
